description: This file implements the AuditorAware interface for Spring Data JPA, providing logic to determine the current user identifier (auditor) for auditing purposes. It retrieves the current user ID from the security context, defaulting to a superuser ID if no user is authenticated.

classes.name: AuditorAwareImpl
classes.description: Implements AuditorAware to provide current auditor information for JPA auditing, based on Spring Security context.

methods.name: getCurrentAuditor
methods.description: Returns an Optional wrapping the current user's ID by extracting it from the SecurityContext, or falls back to a superuser ID.

methods.name: retrieveSuperUser
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the predefined admin user ID, used as a fallback when no authenticated user is available.
